name: design-system
// tags: The three `ds:*` tags are gone with the three projects. They existed to give `@nx/enforce-module-boundaries` a per-project handle on the tokens -> primitives -> compounds direction; inside one project there is no project boundary to hang them on, and the same rule is now enforced by path-scoped `no-restricted-imports` in this project's own `eslint.config.mjs`. `type:ui` is what still carries the npm allow-list (`NPM_ALLOWLIST.ui` in the root config).
// implicit deps: Both former project.json files declared `implicitDependencies: ["design-system-tokens"]`, because primitives and compounds consume tokens through CSS custom properties (.storybook/preview.css) with no TS import, and `nx affected` would otherwise not re-run them after a token change. That edge is internal to this project now and needs no declaration — but the fact behind it still holds: a change under `src/tokens` can break the stories and specs of the other two layers without any TS import connecting them.
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project design-system --web
